source_snapshot.test_name_items: Check system boot time(AC on and warm/cold reboot)
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Insert a node with full configuration and power on it
2. Record the time when entering BIOS setup menu
3. Do a warm reboot
4. Record the time when entering BIOS setup menu
5. Do a cold reboot
6. Record the time when entering BIOS setup menu

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Boot time should meet the customer target:
  For warm boot should not exceed 4 minutes.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Check system boot time(AC on and warm/cold reboot): measure boot time. Agent can measure OS-to-ready boot time via systemd-analyze sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "systemd-analyze 2>&1; systemd-analyze blame 2>&1 | head -n 10 2>&1"; the BIOS-setup-entry warm/cold reboot timing needs an operator to record the moment the setup menu appears.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return systemd-analyze total/kernel/userspace boot time and top startup units so the user can compare against the <4 min warm-boot target; the setup-entry timing is recorded by the operator.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; correctly distinguishes OS timing from operator BIOS-entry timing but risks applying systemd time to the firmware target.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / IMPROVED; separates timing domains, labels run types and notes missing AC/cold targets.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; entry 697/2291 retains the attended BIOS timing boundary.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Measure time to enter BIOS setup for a full-configuration node under initial/AC-on, warm-reboot and cold-reboot paths, applying the explicit <=4-minute target only to the defined warm path.
original_method: An operator installs the full node, defines and timestamps power/reboot t0 and BIOS-entry stop events for each run; automation separately collects OS boot IDs and systemd/journal timing for diagnostic context.
manual_activity: Node insertion/power control and observation of BIOS setup entry are manual; OS timing and boot-log correlation are automated after approved transitions.
required_inputs: Full node configuration and warm/cold/AC-on definitions
Warm <=4-minute target plus AC-on/cold target or report-only policy
safety_requirements: Operator controls node insertion, BIOS observation and approved power/reboot actions.
Do not substitute systemd kernel/userspace time for firmware-to-BIOS-entry time.
Correlate each result to run type, configuration and boot ID with synchronized clocks.
Stop on ambiguous transition, timing, boot failure or BMC loss; no automatic repeat.
agent_execution_scope: Collect systemd-analyze, complete relevant journal/boot IDs, clock state and post-run health, and correlate them to operator timestamps.
Apply the warm target only to the approved warm metric; present other runs against supplied policy without inventing thresholds.
engineer_actions: Install the full node, perform/attest each transition and record BIOS-entry time.
Define missing AC-on/cold acceptance and issue per-run verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: systemd-analyze is useful OS diagnostic evidence, but it cannot measure the source's BIOS setup entry and head-truncated blame is not total boot time.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve complete systemd summary, boot IDs, journal timestamps and time-sync state separately from synchronized operator firmware timing.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The three transition types, warm <=4-minute criterion and 15/15-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use synchronized console/video for power-event-to-BIOS-entry and system logs for firmware/OS diagnostics, labelling each configuration and transition.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Server nodes with accessible BIOS setup and systemd OS diagnostics.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, node configuration, OS/systemd and time-source versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project boot-performance definition and platform power/reboot documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines event semantics and prevents OS time from replacing firmware timing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Supports root-cause attribution while preserving the actual customer metric.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS clocks begin too late to prove initial firmware timing; cold/AC acceptance remains pending if the project provides no target.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define AC-on/cold targets and timing instruments, but must preserve the warm <=4-minute source requirement and disclose the exact metric used.
expected_evidence: Synchronized operator timings for AC-on, warm and cold BIOS entry
Boot IDs, systemd/journal and clock-sync evidence per run

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source names three timing paths but specifies a threshold only for warm; that is a project input gap, not an irreconcilable contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Warm evaluation is defined and other runs can be collected pending project targets; manual firmware timing makes the case PARTIAL rather than blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Corrects the risk of treating systemd time as BIOS-entry time.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its timing-domain separation, run labels and missing-target handling.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Does not downgrade capability solely because AC/cold targets need approval.

review_improvement: Prevents the explicit warm firmware target from being evaluated against a later OS-only interval and preserves useful diagnostics without changing the metric.
independent_technical_reasoning: BIOS-entry timing ends before systemd begins; therefore operator/console timing is primary evidence, while OS timing can explain later boot phases but cannot replace the source measurement.
